description: This file contains the implementation of the FallbackStore class, which is a JSON-based local storage utility for managing recipes within an Android application. It provides functions to retrieve, add, search, and toggle favorite status for recipes, using SharedPreferences to persist data.

classes.name: FallbackStore
classes.description: A singleton class that manages recipe data stored as JSON strings in SharedPreferences, providing methods to access and modify recipes.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all recipes stored in SharedPreferences as a list of RecipeEntity objects.

methods.name: getFavorites
methods.description: Retrieves all recipes marked as favorite.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches recipes by query matching title or description.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Finds a recipe by its unique ID.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new recipe to the store and assigns a unique ID.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a recipe identified by ID.

methods.name: saveAll
methods.description: Persists the entire list of recipes to SharedPreferences.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts a RecipeEntity object into a JSONObject for storage.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSONObject to create a RecipeEntity object.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of FallbackStore, initializing with seed data if empty.
